runtime.entrypoint: Existing functional Host runner; retrieval_tool rich/query_only with memory_control.policy=coalent, embedding config and explicit patched core on PYTHONPATH. CLI --policies coalent. Use the staged retrieval profile.
runtime.query_projection: Literal complete public request plus actual resolved known-evidence receipts. No hidden task labels/evaluator requirements. This is a declared rich-request adapter, not original query-only serialization.
runtime.cache: Original native pool path, explicit existing metered embedder, original extractive LLMSynthesizer; retries0. Defaults synthesis max_tokens/temperature from original owned client, query_structure thinking stage override retained.
runtime.claims: Literal selected claim text packed into the existing source-bound interpretation carrier; unit-level provenance and native metadata retained, no invented graph rules or claim-specific entailment certification.
runtime.originals: Explicit original_source requirements or upstream raw escalation reopen actual Source ranges. Uses retained upstream probe evidence/selected units, then complete-package admission. Does not pretend rewritten claims are original quotations.
runtime.budget: Counts complete common retrieval packet and any external envelope before admitting whole claims/sources; no textual truncation. Existing per-public-turn read allowance, source-query allowance, operation cap and Host generation admission reused.
runtime.operations: Cache-interface call and actual source search/original reopen consume admitted operations. Upstream internal synthesis operations are composite and additionally consume shared Host generation quota; counts are not learned finite-action decisions.
runtime.refs: Existing durable snapshot/ref format, actual delivered indices only, source visibility checked again on replay; unsupported finite-action E2 before/actions replay explicitly rejected.
runtime.cost: All HTTP uses original clients/ledger, no rebilling. Offline measured checks remain pending-v32 until full D queue idle.
